thematic_word_lists.observation: Scribes copy long lists of words by topic, plants, stones, tools and offices, and learn the world through them.

diplomatic_letter_formulary.observation: Letters between courts open with fixed greetings, gift lists and titles, so no ruler is slighted by a careless word.

court_lingua_franca.observation: Palace scribes of many lands learn one court tongue, and letters pass between rulers without interpreters.
court_lingua_franca.social_consequence: Scribes spend years mastering a foreign tongue, and only palaces can afford to train them

omen_compendia.observation: Omens are collected by sign, the liver, the sky, a strange birth, each written with what followed it.

abecedary_letter_order.observation: Children recite the letters in a fixed row, and the row itself becomes a way to number and file.

squared_grid_drawings.observation: Painters rule a grid over a small sketch and a larger one on the wall, and copy it square by square.

wax_writing_boards.observation: Hinged boards coated with wax take a stylus note, and a warmed blade smooths them for the next.

graduated_measuring_rods.observation: Builders carry rods cut with palms and fingers, and every course is set to the same marks.

planet_cycle_tables.observation: Watchers record when the bright wandering star vanishes into the dawn and when it returns, year after year.

sherd_ink_notes.observation: Broken pots take quick ink notes: a ration issued, a debt owed, a man sent to the fields.

weight_conversion_tables.observation: Merchants keep tables that turn one land's weights into another's, and fewer bargains end in quarrels.

ink_on_hide_scrolls.observation: Reed pen and ink on scraped hide make rolls that travel and keep, lighter than any tablet.

eponym_year_lists.observation: Each year is named for the official who held it, and the list of names becomes the town's reckoning of time.

adapted_alphabet_borrowing.observation: Traders take a neighbour's letters and fit them to their own tongue, adding signs where sounds are missing.

eclipse_records.observation: Every darkening of sun and moon is written down with its day, its watch and the omen feared from it.

star_transit_sighting.observation: A plumb line and a slotted rib show the moment a star crosses due south over the watcher's roof.

merchant_letter_accounts.observation: Traders no longer wait on palace scribes; they keep their own accounts in the new letters.

sky_watch_reports.observation: Watchers in each town send the court a written report of what the sky showed, and what it may mean.

full_vowel_alphabet.observation: With signs for the vowels, any word can be written as it is spoken and read aloud by a stranger.
full_vowel_alphabet.ability_reason: A few letters now write every sound of the tongue; reading can be learned in a season rather than in a scribe's lifetime.
full_vowel_alphabet.social_consequence: Writing spreads beyond the scribes, who lose their hold on the written word

written_craft_recipes.observation: Glass, dye and glaze recipes are written down step by step, with weights and firings, so a workshop outlives its master.

astronomical_diaries.observation: Every night the watchers note the moon, the wandering stars, the weather, the river's height and the price of grain.

straightedge_compass.observation: With only a straight rule and a cord pinned at one end, a builder draws right angles, halves and hexagons exactly.

world_maps.observation: A bronze tablet shows the whole known world with the rivers and the sea around it, carried to argue for a war or a voyage.

string_ratio_harmonics.observation: Halve the string and it sounds the same note higher; two to three sounds the fifth, and number is heard in music.

natural_philosophy_schools.observation: Teachers and their pupils argue openly about what the world is made of and why it changes, and every answer invites a rival.
natural_philosophy_schools.ability_reason: Students argue causes in the open: the world is explained by water, air or number, and each explanation is tested against its rivals.
natural_philosophy_schools.social_consequence: Teachers who explain the world by causes unsettle those who explain it by the god's will alone

eclipse_cycle_prediction.observation: Knowing the long cycle, the watchers warn the court months ahead when the sun will darken.

letter_schools_for_citizens.observation: Ordinary children learn letters and sums from a paid teacher in the shade of the market.
letter_schools_for_citizens.social_consequence: Children spend their mornings at letters instead of in the fields and workshops

demonstrated_geometry.observation: A claim about triangles is accepted only when it is shown step by step from what is already agreed.

authored_prose_treatises.observation: Writers set their own names to prose books on nature, healing and the heavens, and answer each other by name.

star_weather_almanac.observation: A stone slab in the square lists the star risings with a peg moved each day, and the weather each one brings.

nineteen_year_cycle.observation: Seven extra months set into nineteen years keep the moon's months in step with the sun's seasons.

seasonal_hour_sundial.observation: Curved lines on the dial give twelve hours of daylight in every season, long in summer and short in winter.

incommensurable_lengths.observation: The diagonal of a square is shown to share no measure with its side, however small the unit is made.

rhetoric_handbooks.observation: Handbooks teach how to arrange a speech, move a jury and answer an opponent's strongest point.
rhetoric_handbooks.social_consequence: Persuasion becomes a craft to be bought, and juries learn to distrust fine speakers

letter_substitution_cipher.observation: Commanders write dispatches with every letter shifted along the row, so a captured messenger betrays nothing.

pigeon_message_post.observation: Birds bred at the capital carry thin rolled notes home from distant posts within a day.

syllogistic_logic.observation: Teachers set out which forms of argument must give a true conclusion from true premises, and which only seem to.
syllogistic_logic.ability_reason: Arguments can be checked by their form: from two agreed premises a conclusion follows or it does not.

descriptive_natural_history.observation: Plants and animals are described by their parts, habits and uses, and sorted into kinds and families.

counting_board_abacus.observation: Pebbles on a ruled board let a merchant add and take away large sums faster than any scribe.

geometric_optics_treatise.observation: A treatise shows that sight runs in straight lines, and works out shadows and the angles of mirrors by geometry.

ratio_proportion.observation: Proportion lets a builder scale a model up to a temple, or partners share a profit by their stakes.

similar_triangles.observation: From a staff and its shadow, the height of a tower or the width of a river is found without climbing or crossing.

combinatorics.observation: Scholars count how many ways letters, verses or lots can be arranged and chosen.

axiomatic_geometry_compendium.observation: One book sets out definitions and agreed first principles, and derives every figure from them in order.
axiomatic_geometry_compendium.ability_reason: Geometry becomes one ordered book built from stated first principles; every later builder, surveyor and sky-watcher learns the same proofs.

endowed_scholar_house.observation: Salaried readers live, study and teach at the ruler's expense beside a great collection of books.
endowed_scholar_house.ability_reason: Scholars are paid to study, copy and teach full time beside one great collection, and inquiry no longer depends on private wealth.
endowed_scholar_house.social_consequence: The scholars eat at the court's table and owe it their loyalty

author_subject_catalogues.observation: Every roll in the collection is listed by author and subject, with its opening words and its length.

lever_moments.observation: Weight times distance on each side of the pivot must balance, so the long arm lifts the heavy load.

displacement_buoyancy.observation: A body in water is pressed upward by the weight of the water it pushes aside.

earth_circumference_measure.observation: Noon shadows at two towns a known distance apart give the size of the whole earth.

centers_of_mass.observation: Every body balances on one point, and builders and shipwrights find it before they lift or load.

hydrostatic_pressure.observation: Water presses harder the deeper it stands, so cisterns and dams are built thicker at the base.

mineral_specific_gravity.observation: Weighed in air and then in water, an ingot shows whether its gold has been thinned with silver.

exhaustion_area_method.observation: Curved areas and volumes are hemmed in by ever finer straight-sided figures until no gap remains.

collated_critical_editions.observation: Editors compare many copies of an old poem line by line, and mark every reading they doubt.

liberal_curriculum.observation: Free-born boys pass through a fixed course: grammar, speaking, number, music and the sky.
liberal_curriculum.social_consequence: One course shapes every educated man alike, and what lies outside it is thought unfit for learning

parchment_record_preparation.observation: Hides scraped thin under tension take ink on both sides and outlast any roll of reed or tablet of clay.
parchment_record_preparation.ability_reason: Records written on prepared hide survive damp, handling and centuries; archives, laws and books stop crumbling away.

reading_marks.observation: Small marks over the letters show stress, breath and pause, so a stranger reads the verse as its poet meant.

counting_rod_decimals.observation: Rods laid in columns, with a blank left for nothing, reckon harvests and taxes in tens.

armillary_sphere.observation: Nested bronze rings model the circles of the sky; sighted through, they give a star's place in degrees.

trigonometry.observation: Tables of chords turn angles into lengths, and distances nobody can walk are found by reckoning.
trigonometry.ability_reason: Chord tables turn angles into lengths: surveyors, sky-watchers and pilots compute what they cannot measure directly.

dioptra_survey.observation: A sighting table on a stand levels an aqueduct's fall and sights across a hill to set a tunnel's line.

torch_alphabet_signals.observation: Torches raised behind two screens spell letters by row and column from hill to hill.

latitude_zones.observation: Lands are ranked by their longest day, and each zone's climate and crops are described.

star_position_catalogue.observation: Stars are listed by position and brightness, so a new star or one that has moved can be noticed.

written_grammar.observation: Grammarians set out the parts of speech and the correct forms, and schoolmasters punish every other.

groma_grid_survey.observation: Surveyors with a cross-staff lay new land out in square lots, each with its boundary stones and number.

geared_sky_calculator.observation: A hand-turned box of bronze gears shows the moon's phase, the wandering stars and coming eclipses on its dials.

dictation_shorthand.observation: Trained clerks take down a speech word for word in quick signs and write it out fair by nightfall.

public_clock_tower.observation: An eight-sided tower shows the hour from a water-clock inside and the wind from a vane on its roof.

posted_public_notices.observation: Each day the officials post the council's acts, trials and news on whitened boards in the square.

leap_year_solar_calendar.observation: The year is fixed at 365 days, with one day added every fourth year, and the months never drift again.
leap_year_solar_calendar.ability_reason: One fixed solar year with a leap day every fourth year: contracts, taxes, sowing and feasts fall on the same day everywhere.

hodometer_distance_count.observation: A wheel turns gears that drop a pebble at every thousand paces, and a road is measured without counting steps.

red_black_rod_negatives.observation: Red rods for gain and black rods for debt let a reckoner carry what is owed through a sum.

mechanical_treatises.observation: Engineers write treatises on siphons, pumps, air-driven devices, throwing engines and lifting machines.

encyclopedic_compendia.observation: One great work gathers farming, healing, building, war and the other known arts into many books.

salaried_public_teachers.observation: Towns pay teachers of speech and letters from public funds, and the posts are fiercely competed for.

number_theory_treatise.observation: A treatise sets out the kinds of numbers, prime, perfect, square and oblong, and proves their properties.

bookbinding_assemblies.observation: Leaves are stacked, folded and sewn at the spine, and a whole work opens at any page.
bookbinding_assemblies.ability_reason: The bound book holds a whole work in one volume; readers find a passage at once, and texts are carried and copied more easily.

ground_tremor_detector.observation: A bronze jar drops a ball from a beast's mouth toward the quarter where the earth has shaken.

coordinate_gazetteer_maps.observation: Towns and river mouths are listed by two numbers, so any mapmaker can place them on the same grid.

sky_tables_compendium.observation: One compendium models every moving light in the sky, with tables to compute where each will stand.
sky_tables_compendium.ability_reason: A trained reader can now compute any planet's place or any eclipse from one book of models and tables.

lead_point_ruling.observation: Scribes rule faint lines with a lead point before writing, and every page keeps the same layout.

cursive_document_hand.observation: Clerks write joined letters at speed; documents multiply, though later readers struggle with the hand.

chapter_contents_lists.observation: Books are divided into numbered chapters, with a list of the contents at the front.

scaled_grid_mapping.observation: Maps drawn to scale on a grid, with measured bearings between towns, guide armies and road-builders.

syncopated_algebra.observation: Problems are written with short signs for the unknown and its powers, and solved in fewer lines.

polygon_circle_estimation.observation: Doubling a polygon's sides inside and outside a circle hems in the circle's ratio ever more closely.

scholarly_commentaries.observation: Commentators explain the old treatises line by line, and new thought increasingly takes the form of notes.
scholarly_commentaries.social_consequence: Learning bends toward explaining the old books rather than questioning them

translation_bureaus.observation: Paid translators render foreign books on healing, number and the sky into the home tongue.

epitome_digests.observation: Short digests replace the long works they summarize, and the long works are no longer copied.
epitome_digests.social_consequence: Readers gain the gist quickly, while the full works quietly stop being copied and are lost

excerpt_anthologies.observation: Collectors copy the best passages of many authors into one volume, and much survives only there.
